verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents Sprites as isolated per-agent Linux boxes: hardware-isolated VMs with a clean baseline per request, egress locking, and disposability. Checkpoints allow rollback in seconds, and access grants can be scoped down to a single endpoint so a sandbox never reaches privileged services. Together these give an agent a disposable environment that stays walled off from production. Missing for 10: explicit docs on separating staging or test data from production (e.g., database branching or seeded test data), and independent hands-on corroboration of Sprite sandboxing.
